guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: Metrics show a massive +886% spike in recommendationservice memory and extreme disk I/O, directly correlating with its +1640% latency increase. Traces confirm frontendservice errors stem from request paths that traverse recommendationservice, while all other services remain within normal baselines.

proposed_fix.description: Increase memory limits for recommendationservice and restart pods to clear the memory leak/thrashing, then monitor for recurrence.
